landing.heroDescription: SoroWill is a trustless on-chain inheritance protocol. Lock USDC, name your beneficiaries, and let a smart contract carry out your wishes if you ever go silent.

lockUsdc.title: Lock USDC
lockUsdc.description: Deposit USDC into a SoroWill contract and name your beneficiaries with percentage splits.

checkInRegularly.title: Check in regularly
checkInRegularly.description: Prove you're still active with a simple check-in before your deadline passes.

missTriggersGrace.title: Miss a check-in triggers grace period
missTriggersGrace.description: If you miss the deadline, anyone can trigger the will — starting a grace period for you to respond.

fundsRelease.title: Funds release to heirs automatically
fundsRelease.description: If the grace period expires without a response, the contract splits your USDC to your beneficiaries.

trustless.title: Trustless
trustless.description: No lawyer, no court, no middleman. The contract enforces the outcome exactly as configured.

automatic.title: Automatic
automatic.description: Anyone can trigger a missed check-in or release funds once conditions are met — no gatekeeper required.

reversible.title: Reversible
reversible.description: Cancel anytime while you're active, or update your beneficiaries whenever your circumstances change.
